title: Corrosive Flail

sources.title: Corrosive Strike
markers: | description = Deal additional {{DamageType|Acid}} damage equal to your [[Proficiency Bonus]]. On a hit, create a pool of acid around the target which reduces {{ArmourClass}} by 2.

summary: This +1 flail can strike nearby creatures and create armour-reducing acid pools.

fields.Corrosive Strike: Action once per Short Rest with weapon proficiency. Make a melee weapon attack that adds your proficiency bonus as Acid damage. A hit creates an acid pool with a 5 ft radius for 3 turns, reducing AC by 2. The attack can strike nearby creatures and objects including allies, creating further pools.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
